title: command: a command queued for the coming day, or refused with the engine's reason
description: The answer of set_intent, withdraw_intent, set_limit, set_leave, approve and cancel_plan. The command is checked at once by taking it in after the commands already queued; a refused command is not queued. A command queued can still be refused when the day begins if the state has changed.

reason.description: For a refused command: the engine's reason in words, in your numbers.

intent.description: For a set_intent with no number given: the number chosen.
